newsitem.title: MOROCCO: SPAIN, MOROCCO FINISH $250 MLN ELECTRICITY LINK.
newsitem.headline: SPAIN, MOROCCO FINISH $250 MLN ELECTRICITY LINK.

text.p: A $250 million undersea electricity link between southern Spain and Morocco was finished this week, the Office Nationale de l'Electricite (ONE) said on Friday.
"The 400 KV undersea electricity grid project linking Spain to Morocco was completed after four years" an ONE spokesman said.
While the link under the Gibraltar straights has been tested power will not be exported commercially from Spain to its southern neighbour before the end of the year, the spokesman said.
The project's total cost was 2.5 billion dirhams ($250 million), of which 700 million dirhams was for the undersea section, says the state-owned ONE.
